sections.heading: Overview
sections.content: At Select & Save, your privacy is our top priority. Select & Save is engineered as a privacy-first, local-first Chrome Extension.

sections.heading: 1. Zero Remote Server Storage
sections.content: All text snippets, QnA cards, captured selection screenshots, custom folders, and tags are saved exclusively in your browser local storage (chrome.storage.local). Select & Save operates no remote cloud databases to store your notes.

sections.heading: 2. On-Device AI Processing
sections.content: AI interactions use Chrome Built-in AI (Gemini Nano Prompt API). Prompts and responses execute locally on your device hardware with zero data transmitted to remote AI clouds.

sections.heading: 3. Chrome Extension Permissions
sections.content: Permissions requested (storage, activeTab, scripting, tabs, all_urls) are used solely to capture user-selected text, render selection overlays, crop visual screenshots, and apply deep-link text fragment markers.

sections.heading: 4. Analytics & Telemetry
sections.content: Optional telemetry via Google Analytics 4 tracks aggregate event counts. No text selections, URLs, note content, or personal identifiers are ever logged. Users can opt out anytime in settings.

sections.heading: 5. Chrome Web Store Compliance
sections.content: We do not sell, trade, or monetize user data. Stored content is never used for advertising, credit profiling, or third-party tracking.
